spot_trading_start.statement: Binance's final-time notice scheduled ARB trading to open at the advanced time of 15:00 UTC on 2023-03-23; its linked original listing identifies ARB/USDT as a spot pair.
spot_trading_start.source_section: Final-time notice and linked original listing

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not immutable copies of the third-party webpages.
The original 17:00 UTC time was explicitly superseded and is not published as the latest fact.
Both pages are first-party Binance sources; evidence_status therefore remains primary_confirmed rather than cross_checked.
